reason: It's free, and I need real prices for a small starter system before I can plan how much to send home. The labels photos matter to me because I can't be there to see what the installer actually puts on my family's roof.
objection: Companies will push a big expensive system when all I can pay for now is a few panels and one battery, and I'm not sure a website can stop an installer in Khartoum from swapping parts once my money is sent.
